title: Smart AI Predictions & Auto-Correct
description: Balanced auto-correction focusing on exact matches and learned words, with quick one-tap restore to original text.

title: Contextual Next-Word Suggestions
description: Analyzes sentence structure and context to provide accurate next-word suggestions as you type.

title: Instant Math Solver
description: Type any equation starting with '=' (e.g. '=4*25') and RCKeyboard instantly displays the calculated answer in the suggestion bar.

title: 100% On-Device Local Privacy
description: All predictions, corrections, and dictionaries are stored and processed locally using a secure SQLite database. Zero typing data sent to external servers.

title: Sensitive Field Auto-Protection
description: Detects password and payment input fields automatically, turning off learning and data logging during sensitive entries.

title: Auto-Clearing Secure Clipboard
titleAr: حافظة نصوص آمنة مع تنظيف تلقائي
description: Built-in clipboard manager automatically purges unpinned snippets after a set duration to safeguard confidential text.

title: Native Kotlin Performance
description: Engineered natively with Kotlin for minimal keystroke latency, smooth frame rates, and negligible battery consumption.

title: Trackpad Cursor Control Mode
description: Long-press spacebar and glide your finger to move the cursor with pinpoint accuracy across long text blocks.

title: Full Color & Theme Customization
description: Customize background hues, key colors, font styles, text colors, and transparency settings to match your personal style.

title: Custom Images & Font Files (TTF/OTF)
description: Set custom photo backgrounds with adjustable opacity and load custom font files (TTF/OTF) for unique typography.

title: Multilingual & Live Translation
description: Full native support for Arabic, English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Turkish, and Russian with inline direct translation.
